narr: An upper level low moved over Texas and interacted with a warm, moist airmass generating thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced damaging wind gusts, large hail, and heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Additional thunderstorms developed during the evening of the 30th.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A low water crossing gauge indicated water over the roadway on CR 1492 at the Blanco River southwest of Wimberley.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding in Schertz. Flooding closed Lower Seguin Rd. at Weir Rd. at Cibolo Creek.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A low water crossing gauge showed water over the roadway on S. Old Bastrop Hwy at Cottonwood Creek south of San Marcos.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding in Schertz. Flooding closed FM 1518 at Oak St. along Cibolo Creek.
